bars.rationale: fact_ids is a JSON-schema enum of exactly the retrieved ids, so an out-of-context citation is ungrammatical. A miss here is an adapter, schema or backend bug — NOT model non-compliance. Triage the plumbing before touching the prompt.
Constrained decode guarantees a schema-valid object. Any parse failure means the backend ignored `format`, which invalidates every other number in the run.
The recorder refuses takes that would not fit num_ctx. A non-zero rate means prompts outgrew the window and the run is not measuring what it claims.
Fraction of factual segments carrying at least one citation. The model declares segment kind itself, so this is a genuine behavioural measure. Below the bar, iterate the prompt.

Of the expected facts that retrieval actually surfaced, how many the model cited. This is the model's job. A miss indicts the prompt. Set at 0.5 because a 2-3 segment answer cannot cite all four expected facts — this bar asks for half, not completeness.

Of ALL expected facts, how many were cited end to end. Lower than model_recall by construction: it also fails when retrieval did not surface the fact. A system miss with a model pass is a RETRIEVAL problem — iterate the intent scorer, not the prompt.
Fraction still ungrounded after the one permitted retry. Some failure is expected from a 7B model; a high rate means the contract is not learnable from the prompt as written.
Fraction needing the corrective regeneration. Diagnostic rather than a quality bar: high retry with low hard-failure means the repair instruction works but the first attempt does not.
